package practice

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

const maximumStagingResponseBytes int64 = 256 << 10

type Client struct {
	BaseURL, StagingToken string
	HTTPClient            *http.Client
}

func (client Client) Stage(ctx context.Context, jobID string, artifact domain.AuthoringArtifact) (domain.StagingReceiptV1, error) {
	if !domain.ValidSurfaceClassification(artifact.Candidate.Blueprint.Classification.SurfaceClassification) {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: blueprint surface classification is required", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"schema": "practice-task-staging-command.v1", "authoring_job_id": jobID,
		"candidate_digest": artifact.CandidateDigest, "contract_digest": artifact.ContractDigest,
		"capabilities_digest": artifact.CapabilitiesDigest, "candidate": artifact.Candidate,
		"verification": artifact.Verification,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/authoring/v1/task-revisions/stage", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.StagingToken)
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", jobID)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated && response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, fmt.Errorf("practice staging returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: maximumStagingResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var envelope struct {
		domain.StagingReceiptV1
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return domain.StagingReceiptV1{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return envelope.StagingReceiptV1, nil
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
}

var _ domain.PracticeStager = Client{}
